title: CAD Deep AI — Deep Learning, Deep Reasoning, Physics-Informed, Generative AI

units.title: Deep Learning for CAD domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 deep learning domains: cad_geometry_learning (PointNet, GNN), cad_feature_learning (LSTM/Transformer), cad_sketch_learning (constraint graphs), cad_dfm_learning (gradient boosting), cad_tolerance_learning (Bayesian), cad_model_embedding (SimCLR, VAE), cad_part_classification (RF, XGBoost), cad_anomaly_detection (Isolation Forest)

units.title: Deep Reasoning for CAD domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 deep reasoning domains: cad_causal_reasoning (causal DAGs, do-calculus), cad_constraint_reasoning (SAT/SMT, Z3), cad_what_if_analysis (Monte Carlo, Sobol), cad_tradeoff_reasoning (Pareto, TOPSIS), cad_dfm_reasoning (5 Whys, FTA), cad_tolerance_reasoning (RSS, Monte Carlo), cad_assembly_reasoning (fit classification, clearance), cad_feature_dependency (dependency graphs)

units.title: Physics-Informed CAD AI domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 physics-informed domains: cad_stress_analysis (PINNs, FEA), cad_thermal_analysis (thermal resistance), cad_deflection_prediction (beam theory), cad_material_optimization (Ashby charts), cad_weight_optimization (topology optimization), cad_fatigue_analysis (S-N curves, Goodman), cad_modal_analysis (natural frequency), cad_cfd_guidance (Reynolds, turbulence)

units.title: Generative AI for CAD domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 generative AI domains: cad_geometry_generation_llm (RAG, chain-of-thought), cad_sketch_synthesis (VAE, GNN), cad_feature_synthesis (seq2seq, tree networks), cad_code_generation (CADQuery, OpenSCAD), cad_parametric_inference (symbolic regression), cad_design_completion (autoregressive), cad_style_transfer (GAN, style embedding), cad_optimization_synthesis (SIMP, BESO)

units.title: Expert prompts and tribal synthesis
units.details: Created Claude Opus-level expert prompts for all 32 domains. Added all domains to manufacturingDomains array for tribal knowledge injection.

units.title: Comprehensive test suite
units.details: 68 tests covering: deep learning (16), deep reasoning (16), physics-informed (16), generative AI (16), tribal synthesis (4)

physics_references.thermal: Fourier law, thermal resistance networks, CFD

integration_points.cadDispatcher: Available for routing to CAD AI reasoning
integration_points.prism_cad MCP tool: All domains callable via PRISM CLI

summary: Comprehensive CAD Deep AI with 32 new domains across 4 categories: Deep Learning (8 domains for geometry/feature/sketch learning, embeddings, classification), Deep Reasoning (8 domains for causal/constraint/DFM/tolerance reasoning), Physics-Informed (8 domains for stress/thermal/deflection/fatigue analysis), Generative AI (8 domains for LLM geometry generation, sketch synthesis, code generation). All domains have expert prompts and tribal synthesis. 68 tests passing. Ready for PRISM CLI integration.
